summary: v2.0.6 verification: Maven unit tests 87/87 pass (SignalFlow fallback removed). Backend pytest 11/11 pass after fixing missing text/markdown MIME for demo .md files. Frontend home renders all 6 sections and plugin-jar link resolves correctly. Demo HTML contains all required v2.0.6 tokens (Visual Analytics JMeter/Splunk O11y/AWS CloudWatch, Test window, Baseline delta table, etc.) and no forbidden tokens (Latency percentiles / distribution / Throughput per transaction). Performance_Report.md contains all required sections and required table markers. PDF and PPTX correctly 404. Path traversal blocked.

minor.issue: Was served with Content-Type application/octet-stream instead of text/markdown. Fixed by adding '.md' to the media map in server.py download_demo(). Now returns 'text/markdown; charset=utf-8'.

issues: Sub-title still reads 'Enterprise Performance Test Reporting Framework - v2.0.4' but the plugin jar and info API report v2.0.6. Update the version label in the frontend header.

action_items: Update the frontend home header subtitle from 'v2.0.4' to 'v2.0.6' to match the shipped jar.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py download_demo() media map was missing '.md' - defaulted to application/octet-stream (fixed in this iteration). Consider centralising the demo/docs/docker MIME maps into one helper to avoid drift.
server.py: HEAD requests on /api/downloads/demo/{name} return 405. FileResponse+GET works, but some clients (curl -I) will get 405. Optional to add HEAD support.
updated_files: /app/backend/server.py (added .md -> text/markdown; charset=utf-8 to download_demo media map)
context_for_next_testing_agent: v2.0.6 release verified end-to-end. Only outstanding item is the cosmetic frontend header version string ('v2.0.4' -> 'v2.0.6'). If main agent fixes it, a quick screenshot re-check is sufficient.
rca of the issue: The Markdown MIME regression came from the demo download handler having its own literal media-map that never listed '.md'. When the Markdown exporter added Performance_Report.md, the file fell through to the 'application/octet-stream' default, which failed the review-request MIME assertion. Fix: registered '.md' -> 'text/markdown; charset=utf-8' in the demo handler; verified via curl and pytest.
